nodes.title: Python Programming Fundamentals
nodes.description: Master core syntax, data structures (lists, dicts), control flow, functions, and modules in Python.

nodes.title: Relational Databases & SQL Basics
nodes.description: Learn SELECT, WHERE, JOINs, GROUP BY, aggregations, and subqueries for querying relational databases.

nodes.title: Applied Math & Statistics for Data Science
nodes.description: Descriptive statistics, probability distributions, hypothesis testing, linear algebra, and calculus foundations.

nodes.title: Data Manipulation with NumPy & Pandas
nodes.description: Efficient vector operations with NumPy and data manipulation, cleaning, and transformation with Pandas DataFrames.

nodes.title: Exploratory Data Analysis & Visualization
nodes.description: Build insightful charts and dashboards using Matplotlib, Seaborn, and Plotly to discover data patterns.

nodes.title: Feature Engineering & Data Preprocessing
nodes.description: Handle missing values, encoding categorical variables, feature scaling, dimensionality reduction (PCA), and feature selection.

nodes.title: Supervised Machine Learning with Scikit-Learn
nodes.description: Build, evaluate, and tune classification and regression models (Linear/Logistic Regression, Decision Trees, Random Forests, XGBoost).

nodes.title: Unsupervised Learning & Clustering
nodes.description: Discover hidden clusters and patterns using K-Means, Hierarchical Clustering, DBSCAN, and anomaly detection.

nodes.title: Deep Learning & Neural Networks with PyTorch
nodes.description: Neural network architectures, backpropagation, CNNs for computer vision, RNNs, and PyTorch framework mastery.

nodes.title: Natural Language Processing & LLM Fine-Tuning
nodes.description: Text tokenization, embeddings, HuggingFace Transformers, RAG architecture, and fine-tuning Large Language Models.

nodes.title: MLOps & Model Deployment
nodes.description: Serve ML models with FastAPI/Flask, track experiments with MLflow, containerize with Docker, and monitor model drift.

nodes.title: End-to-End Predictive Data Science Project
nodes.description: Build a production-grade data science application from data ingestion to model deployment and interactive web dashboard.

nodes.title: Version Control for Data Projects
nodes.description: Use Git and GitHub to version notebooks, datasets, experiments, and collaborative data projects.

nodes.title: Exploratory Data Analysis
nodes.description: Apply a repeatable EDA workflow to inspect distributions, relationships, outliers, and data quality.

nodes.title: Supervised Learning: Regression
nodes.description: Build regression models with linear and polynomial methods, regularization, and regression evaluation metrics.

nodes.title: Supervised Learning: Classification
nodes.description: Train classification models and evaluate precision, recall, F1, ROC-AUC, and class imbalance strategies.

nodes.title: Ensemble Methods
nodes.description: Use random forests, gradient boosting, bagging, boosting, stacking, XGBoost, and LightGBM.

nodes.title: Model Validation & Tuning
nodes.description: Design train, validation, and test splits, cross-validate models, and tune hyperparameters without leakage.

nodes.title: Deep Learning Foundations
nodes.description: Understand neural networks, backpropagation, gradient descent, activation functions, losses, and optimizers.

nodes.title: Deep Learning Frameworks
nodes.description: Train models with TensorFlow, Keras, and PyTorch, including the basics of GPU-accelerated training.

nodes.title: Computer Vision
nodes.description: Prepare images, build CNN-based models, use augmentation and transfer learning, and explore object detection.

nodes.title: Time Series Analysis
nodes.description: Decompose trends and seasonality, build ARIMA and Prophet forecasts, and evaluate time-series predictions.

nodes.title: Model Deployment
nodes.description: Serve trained models through Flask or FastAPI, design ML REST APIs, version models, and package services with Docker.

nodes.title: MLOps Practices
nodes.description: Track experiments, automate ML pipelines, monitor drift, and manage reproducible production workflows.

nodes.title: Big Data with Apache Spark
nodes.description: Process large datasets with Spark and learn distributed computing patterns for data science workloads.

nodes.title: Cloud Machine Learning Platforms
nodes.description: Use managed training, storage, and deployment services on AWS SageMaker, GCP Vertex AI, or Azure ML.

nodes.title: Responsible AI
nodes.description: Assess bias and fairness, explain model decisions, and apply privacy and ethical practices to ML systems.

nodes.title: HTML5 & Modern CSS Foundations
nodes.description: Master semantic HTML tags, CSS Flexbox, Grid, responsive design, and CSS variables.

nodes.title: JavaScript Fundamentals & DOM Manipulation
nodes.description: Variables, data types, functions, DOM selection, event listeners, and ES6+ features (arrow functions, destructuring).

nodes.title: Git Version Control & GitHub Workflow
nodes.description: Branching, merging, commit hygiene, pull requests, resolving merge conflicts, and GitHub collaboration.

nodes.title: Asynchronous JavaScript & REST APIs
nodes.description: Promises, async/await, fetch API, JSON parsing, error handling, and integrating third-party REST APIs.

nodes.title: React Core Principles & Hooks
nodes.description: JSX, components, props, state (useState), side effects (useEffect), refs, and React component lifecycle.

nodes.title: Tailwind CSS & Component Design Systems
nodes.description: Utility-first styling with Tailwind CSS, custom design tokens, dark mode, animation utilities, and accessible UI components.

nodes.title: TypeScript for Web Developers
nodes.description: Type annotations, interfaces, generics, union types, type narrowing, and typing React props and API responses.

nodes.title: Advanced State Management (Zustand / Redux)
nodes.description: Global application state management, context API, Zustand store design, immutability, and state persistence.

nodes.title: Next.js App Router & Server Components

nodes.title: Frontend Testing & Web Performance Optimization
nodes.description: Unit testing with Vitest/Jest, component testing with React Testing Library, Core Web Vitals, code splitting, and memoization.

nodes.title: Production React/Next.js Web Application Capstone
nodes.description: Build and deploy a feature-rich, high-performance web application with full state management, API integration, and polished UI.

nodes.title: How the Web Works
nodes.description: Learn how the internet, HTTP, DNS, hosting, browsers, and rendering engines work together.

nodes.title: Package Managers & Build Tools
nodes.description: Use npm, yarn, or pnpm, understand module bundlers, and configure frontend environments.

nodes.title: CSS Frameworks & Styling Systems
nodes.description: Build consistent interfaces with Tailwind, Sass, CSS-in-JS, and component libraries.

nodes.title: JavaScript Deep Dive
nodes.description: Master closures, higher-order functions, prototypes, classes, error handling, and browser APIs.

nodes.title: Frontend Testing
nodes.description: Test frontend behavior with unit, component, and end-to-end testing tools such as Vitest, RTL, and Playwright.

nodes.title: Frontend Performance Optimization
nodes.description: Improve loading and runtime performance with code splitting, lazy loading, memoization, and Core Web Vitals.

nodes.title: Accessibility & UX
nodes.description: Create accessible, responsive interfaces with WCAG principles, keyboard navigation, and screen-reader support.

nodes.title: API Integration
nodes.description: Consume REST and GraphQL APIs, implement authentication flows, and work with WebSockets.

nodes.title: Modern Meta-Frameworks
nodes.description: Apply SSR, SSG, ISR, data fetching, and routing patterns in Next.js and comparable meta-frameworks.

nodes.title: Frontend Build & Deployment
nodes.description: Ship frontend applications with CI/CD, static hosting, containers, and production error tracking.

nodes.title: Frontend Security
nodes.description: Protect browser applications with secure authentication, CORS, CSP, XSS, and CSRF prevention.

nodes.title: Advanced Frontend Tooling
nodes.description: Adopt advanced linting, formatting, monorepo, micro-frontend, and module-federation workflows.

nodes.title: Design Systems
nodes.description: Design reusable components with Storybook, themes, design tokens, and maintainable UI principles.

nodes.title: Linux Systems & Bash Shell Scripting
nodes.description: File system navigation, permissions, process management, text processing (grep, awk, sed), and automation scripts.

nodes.title: Computer Networking & Web Protocols
nodes.description: TCP/IP, DNS resolution, HTTP/HTTPS, SSL/TLS certificates, reverse proxies (Nginx), firewalls, and ports.

nodes.title: Git & Code Repository Management
nodes.description: Git branching strategies (GitFlow, trunk-based), hooks, tagging, release management, and repository security.

nodes.title: Containerization with Docker
nodes.description: Dockerfiles, image optimization, multi-stage builds, container lifecycle, volumes, and networking.

nodes.description: Define and run multi-container Docker applications (web, DB, cache) with YAML configurations and environment variables.

nodes.title: CI/CD Pipelines with GitHub Actions
nodes.description: Automated linting, testing, building, and deployment workflows triggered on git commits and pull requests.

nodes.title: Infrastructure as Code (IaC) with Terraform
nodes.description: Provision and manage cloud infrastructure declaratively using HashiCorp Terraform HCL, modules, and state files.

nodes.description: Deploy, scale, and manage containerized applications using Pods, Deployments, Services, Ingress, and Helm charts.

nodes.title: Scripting for Automation

nodes.title: Package & Dependency Management
nodes.description: Manage dependencies and reproducible environments for Node.js and other operational tooling.

nodes.description: Design cloud VPCs, subnets, routes, CDNs, and managed DNS for reliable application delivery.

nodes.title: Security & Compliance
nodes.description: Apply secrets management, pipeline security scanning, least-privilege IAM, and compliance fundamentals.

nodes.title: Site Reliability Engineering
nodes.description: Define SLIs, SLOs, and SLAs, respond to incidents, run postmortems, and plan service capacity.

nodes.title: Serverless Computing
nodes.description: Build event-driven systems with Lambda or Cloud Functions, API Gateway, and serverless frameworks.

nodes.title: Advanced Kubernetes
nodes.description: Operate Kubernetes with service meshes, GitOps, custom resources, operators, and multi-cluster management.

nodes.title: Multi-Cloud & Hybrid Cloud
nodes.description: Compare cloud providers, connect hybrid environments, and optimize cost across multiple platforms.

nodes.title: Platform Engineering
nodes.description: Build internal developer platforms and self-service infrastructure that improves developer experience.

nodes.description: Plan backups, multi-region architectures, failover procedures, and highly available production services.
